basis: Initial engineering acceptance policy, not a statistically calibrated production guarantee.
none_recall_definition: Correct empty outputs / all expected NONE cases; derive from report.cases, since existing harness does not publish this metric.

all_cases: Diagnosis and Why Now use requested language
Why Now relates to concrete task facts rather than repeating a generic trigger
No unsupported source claim or fabricated task fact
human_review.multi_concept_cases: Each requested complementary aspect should be covered; review misses explicitly because Top-1 alone does not verify all expected IDs.

real_usage.apply_rate_definition: Distinct (run_id, concept_id) pairs with applied / distinct pairs with recommended, among runs whose feedback window has closed. NONE runs have no recommendation pair and are not denominator entries.
real_usage.feedback_window: 24 hours after the run, or explicit terminal feedback for all recommended items; report unresolved count separately.
real_usage.threshold_status: Initial observation threshold; not measured from the synthetic dataset.
